## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 402 captures during March 2019. Activity was completed as part of the clinic’s routine service, with the recorded captures submitted for assessment. The available activity information provides the basis for reviewing image quality and subsequent grading outcomes for the month.

## Image quality

Of the 402 captures, 14 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.5. The result should be monitored through routine quality review, with attention given to any recurring issues that may affect the usability of images. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

There were 67 referable results recorded for March 2019. The median lag from capture to grading was 6 days. These figures should be considered alongside the activity and image-quality results when reviewing the clinic’s monthly performance. No further operational issues were identified in the information provided for this reporting period.
